reasons: With a 4 MC per-semester limit, only six 4 MC courses fit in semesters 3-8, but nine required courses remain.
CS4238 needs CS3235 and CS2107, and CS4262 needs an added ML course, so even more courses would be required.
CS2100 is fixed in semester 6, but that does not resolve the overall shortage of slots.
